messages:
Maria F: FYI invoice R-2026-059 hit our queue for ACME's on‑prem renewal but there's a line mismatch — platform fee shows 12 months instead of the 9‑month proration we agreed during migration window. Can finance hold payment and propose a credit?
Sam R: Checking — when did they sign the migration addendum? I thought the renewal aligned to calendar but they moved to legacy SKU in Nov.
Jia W: ACME migrated workloads Nov 15 and we granted a 3‑month overlap credit for dual running. Sales noted that in the SOW but the billing export didn't pick up the addendum flag. Customer is on a support downgrade (Premier -> Standard) at renewal too.
BillingBot: Invoice R-2026-059 created (amount: $198,450). Lines:
- PLATFORM_FEE: $150,000 (12mo)
- SUPPORT_PREMIER: $48,450
Reference: <https://invoices.redwood.ai/R-2026-059> :page_facing_up:
Maria F: Can we net a pro‑rated platform fee credit for the 3 months overlap (-$37,500) and switch support SKU to Standard on the renewal invoice? Need approvals before voiding.
Sam R: I'll confirm the signed addendum and attach the doc. If sales approved the overlap, we can issue a credit memo. Carlos M: I approved the migration concession in the account notes on 2025-11-12. I can re-confirm with the customer this afternoon.
Anita L: Before issuing credit memo, legal needs to verify the addendum language covers monetary credits. If the SOW references 'migration credit' it's OK; otherwise we need exec approval. I'll review the doc.
Maria F: Great — @Anita L please flag if we need a signed amendment. If not, finance will draft credit memo and set invoice status to "on hold".
Jia W: Customer asked for the renewal to reflect the support downgrade. They want pricing consistent with Standard support rates starting next billing cycle.
Sam R: Attached addendum confirms "3 months overlap credit" and transition to Standard at renewal. I'll drop the file in the thread in a sec. :white_check_mark:
Maria F: Thanks. Tentative action plan: 1) Put R-2026-059 on hold, 2) issue credit memo -$37,500, 3) reissue invoice with PLATFORM_FEE 9mo and SUPPORT_STANDARD line, 4) notify customer and CS to avoid service interruption. Approvals needed: Legal sign-off and Revenue ops acknowledgment.
Anita L: I reviewed the addendum briefly — language supports a credit but not the exact dollar amount. Legal OK to proceed if sales confirms the numeric calc matches their notes.
Carlos M: Confirmed numeric calc: platform monthly = $12,500, 3 months = $37,500. Proceed.
Maria F: Perfect. @BillingBot can you mark R-2026-059 as "hold: credit_review" and create PR-CR-317 for the credit memo template?
BillingBot: Invoice R-2026-059 status set to: hold: credit_review. Created Credit Request PR-CR-317.
Sam R: I'll message the customer that we paused billing while we reissue to reflect agreed migration terms.
Maria F: I'll prepare the credit memo draft and loop revenue ops for double-check. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
